## Summary

Describe the problem this change addresses and the engineering approach used.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] `npm run build` passes.
- [ ] The relevant API workflow or documentation path was exercised.

## Public-safety gate

- [ ] No credentials, personal data, customer information, production URLs, or raw workflow exports are included.
- [ ] Any new claim is accurate and supportable from this repository.
- [ ] The security impact and rollback approach are described where relevant.

## Reviewer notes

State any intentional limitation, unresolved trade-off, or follow-up issue clearly.
